title: VanillaIshPack
description: This resource pack includes only the essentials for SMP, Singleplayer, and pretty much every PvP gamemode.
body:
### About the pack:
  A simple vanilla-ish resource pack for PvP, survival, smp, and FFA. The pack includes smaller crit particles, no pumpkin overlay, ore borders, dark mode, no enchanted hit particles, no explosion particles, and much more to optimize your Minecraft experience. Also, the images in the gallery might be a bit outdated since I'm constantly updating them.

### Every Major Changes:

- Outlined ores
- Slightly smaller utils and weapons
- Small totem pop animation & particles
- Low fire
- Low shield
- No hit particles
- No explosion particles
- No block breaking particles
- Clearer water
- More visible glowing effect (The inside part of the glowing outline will also glow but with less opacity
